hard_gates.name: memory-bounded-materialization
hard_gates.evidence: AFQC-094 terminated before scoring because the local model path exceeded the usable memory envelope on this host.

hard_gates.name: exact-provider-binding
hard_gates.evidence: The historical local-model binding remains versioned and unchanged.

hard_gates.name: resume-and-corruption-safety
hard_gates.evidence: The historical local path did not complete a corpus materialization to exercise immutable resume and corruption checks.

hard_gates.name: gold-opening-order
hard_gates.evidence: The historical run stopped before scoring and did not open the selected hidden-gold tranche.

hard_gates.name: provider-and-paid-execution-closed
hard_gates.evidence: The historical local execution required no paid provider call and its authority is revoked.

hard_gates.name: memory-bounded-materialization
hard_gates.evidence: Each embedding batch is written transactionally to SQLite and released before the next batch; immutable dense output is streamed in source order.

hard_gates.name: exact-provider-binding
hard_gates.evidence: The adapter validates exact model identity, dimensions, ordered indices, finite vectors, usage, batch size, and token limits.

hard_gates.name: resume-and-corruption-safety
hard_gates.evidence: Focused tests cover interruption, immutable binding, idempotence, checksum rejection, and query-cache resume.

hard_gates.name: gold-opening-order
hard_gates.evidence: All method rankings must be durably persisted before hidden gold can be loaded for scoring.

hard_gates.name: provider-and-paid-execution-closed
hard_gates.evidence: The instrument and repository allowlist both keep provider and paid execution unauthorized; build verification made zero calls.

decision.rationale: The successor removes the local model-memory blocker while retaining repository-owned source registration, BM25, immutable vector artifacts, citation lineage, hidden gold, and deterministic scoring. It is ready for one separately authorized 300-case method decision without changing the active product profile.
limitations: This is build-only evidence and does not establish retrieval quality or select an embedding model.
The comparison uses public open educational sources and excludes the private Academia Vault and student data.
M5 is prospectively fixed to the large-hybrid base so hidden gold cannot choose its parent method after execution.
M6 uses bounded GPT-5.4 nano reranking on at most 40 percent of difficult cases and remains unselected.
The local R1 release profile and the 500+100 and sealed 10,000 product runs remain unchanged and unauthorized.
